boosters_i18n.en: Mystery Coast (officially listed by the New Taipei travel portal beside Shuiwei fishing harbour, Jinshan; a jagged wave-cut shore reached through the narrow 'first-light' tide arch, looking out to Yeliu Islets; the arch is impassable at high tide). Disjoint from tw-161 Zhongjiao Bay 2.34 km away (surf-bay subject vs tide-arch reef subject).
